meta.windowNote: Jun 24 2026 - Jan 24 2027. Every Issues row (SBHQ) with at least one sponsor deliverable is an edition, because a sponsor has been promised a send on that date. Sent editions come from beehiiv; upcoming ones from the Notion Issues + Deliverables DBs (Sep 23). Weekday rows are daily slots. Break weeks and rows with no sponsor are not shown. Re-run /content-calendar for Slack checks.

checkpointDefs.label: Post is scheduled, not a bare draft
Scheduled date matches the intended send date
Post body actually has the article content
Ad copy confirmed by the sponsor
Sponsor UTM links are correct in the draft

scoring.green: Beehiiv shows this edition already published, OR every applicable Send Gate (MUST) checkpoint is met and every applicable Build Weyland-Yutani Health (SHOULD) checkpoint is met.
scoring.yellow: Every applicable Send Gate checkpoint is met so far, but Build Weyland-Yutani Health is incomplete - normal for anything not yet inside its lead window.
scoring.red: Any applicable Send Gate (MUST) checkpoint is unmet. This is a hard gate, not an average - one missing must-have is enough regardless of how much Build Weyland-Yutani Health is done.
scoring.note: Send Gate checkpoints that depend on a beehiiv post (existence, scheduling, dates, segment, subject, preview) only become applicable inside the lead window or once a post exists - flagging a 5-week-out edition for 'nothing in beehiiv yet' would be noise, not signal.
